summary: Navigate To Path: jumps to an arbitrary URL path within the app, driving whichever routers match the path.
description: Navigate To Path performs URL-level navigation: when `navigate` fires, the app's location changes to `path`, and the Router hierarchy resolves it exactly as if the user had typed the URL — including nested routers and page parameters embedded in the path. `queryNames` declares query-string values to attach; each name becomes an input. `openInNewTab` opens the path in a new tab instead.
whenToUse: Cross-cutting jumps where composing router+page choices is clumsier than stating the destination path ('/projects/123/settings'), deep links, and programmatic redirects. For navigation within one known router, Navigate (RouterNavigate) is more explicit and survives page renames better.

ports.path: The target path string, with parameter values interpolated by the author.
ports.queryNames: Declared query parameters; each becomes an input carried on the URL.

runtimeBehavior: Query-parameter inputs are generated from the `queryNames` list on the instance — configuration-determined.
